text: 证监会：融资融券是资本市场重要的基础性制度之一，对平抑非理性波动，促进价格发现，吸引中长期资金入市，满足投资者融资需求具有积极作用。2026年1月，根据当时的市场形势，沪深北交易所将融资保证金比例由80%提高至100%，对减缓杠杆风险顺周期积累、促进理性交易和提前防控风险起到积极作用。近期，融资余额和交易活跃度明显下降，整体杠杆水平趋于稳健。为稳定资本市场、提振投资者信心，促进融资融券业务功能发挥，证监会将会同证券交易所指导证券公司对融资保证金比例、可充抵保证金证券折算率、维持担保比例等风险控制指标进行统筹研究，进一步优化，保持弹性。在风险总体可控的基础
text_en: CSRC: Margin trading and securities lending is one of the important foundational systems of the capital market, playing a positive role in smoothing irrational fluctuations, promoting price discovery, attracting medium- and long-term capital into the market, and meeting investors' financing needs. In January 2026, in light of the market conditions at the time, the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing stock exchanges raised the margin requirement ratio for financing from 80% to 100%, which played a positive role in mitigating the procyclical accumulation of leverage risk, promoting rational trading and preemptively preventing risks. Recently, financing balances and trading activity have declined noticeably, and the overall leverage level has trended toward stability. To stabilize the capital market, boost investor confidence and promote the functioning of margin trading and securities lending business, the CSRC will, together with the stock exchanges, guide securities companies to conduct coordinated research on risk control indicators such as the margin requirement ratio for financing, the conversion rates of securities eligible as margin collateral, and the maintenance margin ratio, and further optimize them while maintaining flexibility.
